validation_scope: Incremental calibration conditional on the published ACAG input; not independent validation of the complete satellite-to-product chain
time_contract: Hourly bins and month boundaries are UTC. Daily records retain their supplied date labels; their original local-day semantics are not independently verified.
annual_contract: Exactly 12 months; equal-month annual average, not a day-weighted or population-weighted exposure
inference: Station-clustered primary estimates; two-way station/calendar-month sensitivity exported separately
